name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
January 25, 2022 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR FOUR CHAPLAINS DAY – It is recommended the City Council proclaim February 3, 2022 as Four Chaplains Day in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to La Mirada VFW Post 9148 Chaplain Rick Berquist.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME CITY EMPLOYEE - It is recommended the City Council welcome Mario Morales Moreno and present him with a $40 gift certificate to Panera, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.2 Introduction of New City Employee
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of January 11, 2022 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of January 11, 2022.
7.1 Minutes of 1-11-22 SS
7.1 Minutes of 1-11-22 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated January 25, 2022 in the total amount of $1,673,338.71.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING DECEMBER 2021 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending December 2021.
7.3 Investment Report
7.4
DEACTIVATION AND REMOVAL OF TRAFFIC SIGNAL AND REPLACEMENT WITH ALL-WAY STOP CONTROLS ON NORTH FIRESTONE BOULEVARD AT NORTHWOODS INN/IQ AIR DRIVEWAYS (585 FEET EAST OF GATEWAY DRIVE) – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council approve the plans and specifications for the traffic signal deactivation and removal plan and all-way stop control signage and striping plan for the North Firestone Boulevard at Northwoods Inn/IQ Air Driveways.
7.4 Deactivation and Removal of Traffic Signal
8.
PUBLIC HEARING
8.1
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM (CDBG) PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 PROJECTS - It is recommended the City Council conduct a Public Hearing as prescribed by law; approve the proposed Fiscal Year 2022-23 Community Development Block Grant projects as presented; and authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments with the Los Angeles County Development Authority on behalf of the City.
8.1 CDBG Program
9.

9.1
RESTAURANT AND MORTGAGE ASSISTANCE – It is recommended the City Council receive an update from staff on restaurant and mortgage assistance programs proposed using funding from the American Rescue Plan Act.
